scope: 12 native/raw/composite/mask comparisons and all 12 2x2 repeat layouts
observations: Native individual stone counts and exposed earth gaps retained.
Broad orange/brown palette and layered flat stone faces preserved; generated earth discarded for accepted master.
No obvious square seams in repeat sheets; diagonal cut contact-shadow defect corrected by distinguishing antialiasing from physical edge coverage.
Masks have slightly rounder outlines and some small boundary stones are inset; native positions remain broadly aligned.
Cap and turn self repeats only screen substrate continuity; they are not valid connected path layouts.
limits: Numerical native pair checks are RGB continuity checks, not proof of every native layout or perspective.
